test_title: PYST 20: SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Nervous
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (4)** "**Courageous.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
• **Nervous - **feeling anxious, apprehensive, or lacking confidence.
 
 
• **Example:** I was very nervous before the interview.
 
 
 
• ​**Courageous** - Not deterred by danger or pain; brave.
 
 
• **Example:** The courageous firefighter saved the child from the burning building.
 
 Therefore, the correct antonym of nervous is courageous.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Option 1 (Hesitant) means showing reluctance or uncertainty.
 
• Option 2 (Shaky) means trembling or unsteady.
 
• Option 3 (Casual) Relaxed and unconcerned or happening by chance without being planned.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

 
• We have to choose the most appropriate option.
 
• Courageous and Casual may be the antonym of nervous. **But** **Courageous is the most appropriate** antonym for Nervous.
